task_completion.description: Load the porcine insulin structure (4INS) into PyMOL.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The PyMOL object list shows '4INS' or a similar name, and a protein structure is visible in the viewer.

task_completion.description: Generate symmetry mates to visualize the crystal lattice.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The PyMOL viewer shows multiple copies of the insulin molecule arranged in a repeating lattice pattern, often indicated by many new objects in the object list (e.g., sym01, sym02).

task_completion.description: Highlight the original molecule differently from its symmetry mates for a publication-quality figure.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The central/original molecule is colored differently (e.g., green vs. grey) or rendered in a different style than the surrounding symmetry mates.

task_completion.description: Save the visualization as a PNG file to the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent uses the 'save' or 'export' command/menu, or a file browser shows 'insulin_packing.png' in the ~/PyMOL_Data/images/ directory.

task_completion.description: Identify at least 5 residues involved in crystal contacts.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent uses selection commands (e.g., 'within') or visual inspection to identify residues at the interface of symmetry mates; these residues are listed in the terminal or report.

task_completion.description: Create a text report with space group, unit cell dimensions, and contact residues.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal output shows the file 'insulin_crystal_report.txt' containing the space group (R 3), unit cell (a=b≈82.5, c≈34.0), and a list of residues.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the PyMOL GUI or command line directly.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the PyMOL interface, command history, or active manipulation of the 3D scene, not just a static image viewer.

integrity.description: The report was generated based on the loaded data, not pre-written text.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen querying the PDB header or using the 'symexp' command before writing the report.

integrity.description: The agent saved files to the specific requested paths.
integrity.visual_evidence: Terminal commands or file dialogs show the paths ~/PyMOL_Data/images/ and ~/PyMOL_Data/.

privileged_info_for_vlm: For PDB 4INS: The space group is 'R 3'. The unit cell dimensions are approximately a=82.5, b=82.5, c=34.0 (alpha=90, beta=90, gamma=120). The agent must save the image to ~/PyMOL_Data/images/insulin_packing.png and the report to ~/PyMOL_Data/insulin_crystal_report.txt. The report must list at least 5 residues involved in contacts between symmetry-related molecules.
